concerns.text: FR-001 requires the system to 'exclude' non-conforming instances (e.g., generation failures) from the final set. Task T016 ('Add error handling for generation failures') is marked incomplete [ ] and lacks the specific logic to log and exclude failed graphs, leaving the spec requirement unimplemented.

FR-003 requires extracting decay rates by fitting a damped sinusoid and validating R² ≥ 0.95. Tasks T022a (fit logic), T022b (validation), and T022c (resonance detection) are marked incomplete [ ]. Without these, the core requirement to extract and validate decay rates is missing.

FR-008 requires generating convergence diagnostics by running simulations on multiple seeds and outputting a variance plot. Task T023a (implement generic convergence algorithm) is marked incomplete [ ], and T024c (generate plot) depends on it. The spec requirement for numerical stability verification is unimplemented.

FR-001 and the Plan require schema contracts (network_schema, energy_schema, regression_schema) to define data structures. Tasks T006a, T006b, and T006c are marked incomplete [ ], meaning the data structure verification required by the spec is missing.

Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) and Plan Phase 1 require a structured environment (directory setup, linting, pre-commit). Tasks T001a (directory structure), T002 (linting config), and T003 (pre-commit hooks) are marked incomplete [ ], violating the reproducibility and project structure requirements.

FR-009 requires reporting loadings of topological metrics on PC1/PC2 with physical interpretation. Task T032 (extract loadings and generate interpretation) is marked incomplete [ ], leaving the spec requirement for interpreting regression components unfulfilled.

Edge Cases require detecting non-convergence, logging the graph ID, and excluding it. Task T027 ('Add robust error handling for non-convergence') is marked incomplete [ ], leaving this critical edge case requirement unaddressed.

Task T028 is tagged with [US2] but describes a power limitation check (dataset size >= 50) mandated by Spec FR-001 (which is US1). While the logic is sound, the tag [US2] is a stale/incorrect reference to the requirement source, creating traceability confusion.
